name: ONLYOFFICE (Linux)
description: ONLYOFFICE Linux compiles out the embedded-signature verifier and relies on feed MD5, but the retained libcurl downloader leaves TLS verification enabled and the feed URL is build-injected. This is a C-tier defense-in-depth gap, not D.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.
